functionalReqs: Index items as embeddings; update as items change
Return top-k semantically similar items for a query
Hybrid with keyword search for exact terms (model numbers)
hints: Brute-force cosine similarity over 300M vectors per query: how long does that take?
Approximate nearest neighbour indexes (HNSW, IVF-PQ) trade recall for speed and memory. How do filters interact with them?

Embedding model (fine-tuned bi-encoder) → vectors in a sharded ANN index (HNSW in memory or IVF-PQ for compression) with metadata filtering (pre- or post-filter) → hybrid score with BM25 (reciprocal rank fusion) → optional cross-encoder re-rank; streaming upserts; re-embed all items when the model changes (versioned index, blue-green swap).
nonFunctionalReqs: Scales to hundreds of millions of vectors
problemStatement:
Design **semantic search** over a large catalogue (articles, products or songs) so that 'cheap phone with good camera' finds relevant items even without matching keywords.

Focus on embeddings, the vector index, and combining semantic with keyword search.
title: Design Semantic Search with a Vector Database
